entities.name: long rebalances
entities.description: Client-side assignment makes rebalances take a long time.
entities.quote: The classic protocol makes clients do assignment, which causes long rebalances.

entities.name: move assignment to the group coordinator
entities.description: Assignment is computed by the coordinator instead of by the clients.
entities.quote: Move assignment to the group coordinator.

entities.name: client-side assignment with incremental cooperative rebalancing
entities.description: Keeping assignment on the client and rebalancing incrementally instead.
entities.quote: Keeping client-side assignment with incremental cooperative rebalancing was rejected because it does not fix coordinator-side fencing.

entities.name: group coordinator
entities.description: The broker-side component that computes assignments and receives heartbeats.
entities.quote: Consumers send heartbeats; the coordinator computes assignments.

entities.name: fence members with stale epochs
entities.description: Members whose epoch is stale are fenced and have to rejoin the group.
entities.quote: Members with stale epochs are fenced and must rejoin.
